描述_EN: despite this, these floral textiles were perennial favourites from the end of the 18th century to about 1900. painted silks like this one were not very durable, as the paint rubs off the surface of the textile rather easily. this silk gauze material was painted in china and then imported into europe to be made up as a quilt.
描述_ZN: 尽管如此，这些花纹纺织品从18世纪末到1900年左右一直是人们的最爱。 像这样的彩绘丝绸并不是很耐用，因为颜料很容易从纺织品的表面擦掉。 这种丝绸纱布材料在中国被涂上了颜色，然后进口到欧洲被做成了被子。
